title: wg: room-policy-04 undefined types and syntax typos
description: Erratum. "Component policy_component_ids<V>" (L580) should be ComponentID; "unit64 max_kp_lifetime" (L1314); WireFormats (L1255, L1308) and ContentType (L1259) undefined (RFC 9420 has WireFormat, ContentType); mismatched comment at L467 (*/ is satisfied */). Decisions mimid-1wgh.3.14, .3.22.
notes: CORRECTION (from .3.8, 2026-10-17): WireFormats is NOT undefined — draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 L877-879 defines struct { WireFormat wire_formats<V>; } WireFormats. The real issue: room-policy §7 'WireFormats wire_formats<V>' read literally is a vector of length-prefixed vectors, unlike sibling fields (ExtensionType extensions<V>), so the intended encoding is ambiguous. Reword before sending.
